latest.title: Liouville Theorem for the Constant $Q/R$-Curvature Equation
latest.abstract: We study positive entire solutions of the flat constant $Q/R$-curvature equation in dimension $n\geq5$. We prove that the weak superharmonicity condition $-Δu\geq0$ already forces every nonconstant solution to be admissible. With this automatic admissibility, we classify all such solutions as positive constants or standard bubbles. We also show that the weak superharmonicity condition is structurally necessary. Once it is removed, there is a one-parameter family of positive radial entire solutions near every positive constant. These solutions converge to a positive constant at infinity, while both $-Δu$ and $-Δ(u^{(n-2)/(n-4)})$ change sign infinitely many times.
latest.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
latest.workSummary: 在 n≥5 的常 Q/R 曲率方程中证明弱超调和性自动给出容许性，并分类为常数或标准泡。
latest.breakthrough: 展示弱超调和条件的结构必要性。
latest.limitations: 去掉该条件有振荡径向解，不能无条件声称全解分类。 已补读所列正文片段；这不是逐行独立证明审查。
